headline: Forest’s chance volume goes unrewarded in Ipswich draw

sentences.text: Ipswich Town and Nottingham Forest shared a 1–1 draw, with both goals arriving before half-time and neither side scoring after the break.
Neco Williams put Nottingham Forest ahead in the 13th minute, and Julio Enciso equalised for Ipswich in the 41st.
The underlying numbers strongly favoured Forest: they recorded 2.29 expected goals to Ipswich’s 0.46 and outshot the hosts 17–7.
Forest also had 5 shots on target to Ipswich’s 3, created 2 big chances to 1 and won 5 corners while Ipswich had none.
Possession was nearly even, at 50.6% for Forest and 49.4% for Ipswich, while pass totals were similarly close at 480 and 486 respectively.
Ipswich’s 4-2-3-1 faced Forest’s 3-4-2-1, and the point moved Ipswich to 9th on 10 points while Forest rose to 16th on 6.
The result extends a mixed five-game run for both: Ipswich had taken 6 points from their preceding 5 league matches, and Forest 4.
